scripts.code:
-- HEISTBLOX INSPECTOR AIO v0.5
-- WindUI 1.6.66
-- Roblox Studio diagnostic edition

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- CONFIGURATION

local Config = {
    PlayerESP = true,
    LootESP = true,
    WeaponInfo = true,
    RoleDetection = true,
    ShowDistance = true,

    Criminals = true,
    Police = true,
    Civilians = true,
    Unknown = true,

    RefreshRate = 1,
    MaxDistance = 1000,
}

local Colors = {
    Criminal = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
    Police = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255),
    Civilian = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
    Unknown = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Loot = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 50),
}

local RoleRGB = {
    ["255,50,50"] = "Criminal",
    ["0,150,255"] = "Police",
    ["200,200,200"] = "Civilian",
}

local RenderedPlayers = {}
local RenderedLoot = {}

local Stats = {
    Players = 0,
    Loot = 0,
    Refreshes = 0,
}

-- WINDUI

local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet(
    "https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/download/1.6.66/main.lua"
))()

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "HEISTBLOX | Inspector",
    Author = "AIO v0.5",
    Icon = "shield",
    Folder = "HeistbloxInspector",
    Theme = "Dark",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(700, 500),
    MinSize = Vector2.new(550, 400),
    Resizable = true,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
})

local Dashboard = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Dashboard",
    Icon = "layout-dashboard",
})

local PlayersTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Players",
    Icon = "users",
})

local LootTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Loot",
    Icon = "package",
})

local SettingsTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Settings",
    Icon = "settings",
})

-- DETECTION

local function getRole(character)
    local highlight = character
        and character:FindFirstChild("SpectatorHighlight")

    if not highlight or not highlight:IsA("Highlight") then
        return "Unknown"
    end

    local color = highlight.FillColor

    local key = string.format("%d,%d,%d",
        math.round(color.R * 255),
        math.round(color.G * 255),
        math.round(color.B * 255)
    )

    return RoleRGB[key] or "Unknown"
end

local function getWeapons(player)
    local weapons = {}

    local function inspect(container)
        if not container then return end

        for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                table.insert(weapons, item.Name)
            end
        end
    end

    inspect(player.Character)
    inspect(player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))

    return #weapons > 0 and table.concat(weapons, ", ") or "Unarmed"
end

local function getDistance(character)
    local root = character
        and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local localRoot = LocalPlayer.Character
        and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not root or not localRoot then return nil end

    return math.floor((root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude)
end

-- PLAYER RENDERER

local function removePlayer(player)
    local data = RenderedPlayers[player]

    if data then
        data.Billboard:Destroy()
        data.Highlight:Destroy()
        RenderedPlayers[player] = nil
    end
end

local function createPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local root = character
        and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not root then return end

    removePlayer(player)

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "InspectorPlayerLabel"
    billboard.Adornee = root
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 65)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.MaxDistance = Config.MaxDistance

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 13
    label.Parent = billboard

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    highlight.Parent = character

    billboard.Parent = PlayerGui

    RenderedPlayers[player] = {
        Billboard = billboard,
        Highlight = highlight,
        Label = label,
        Character = character,
    }
end

-- LOOT RENDERER

local function removeLoot(item)
    local data = RenderedLoot[item]

    if data then
        data.Billboard:Destroy()
        data.Highlight:Destroy()
        RenderedLoot[item] = nil
    end
end

local function createLoot(item)
    if not item:IsA("Model") and not item:IsA("BasePart") then
        return
    end

    local part = item:IsA("Model")
        and (item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
        or item

    if not part then return end

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "InspectorLootLabel"
    billboard.Adornee = part
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 35)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.MaxDistance = Config.MaxDistance

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = item.Name
    label.TextColor3 = Colors.Loot
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.Parent = billboard

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Adornee = item
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    highlight.FillColor = Colors.Loot
    highlight.OutlineColor = Colors.Loot
    highlight.Parent = item

    billboard.Parent = PlayerGui

    RenderedLoot[item] = {
        Billboard = billboard,
        Highlight = highlight,
    }
end

-- UPDATE ENGINE

local function update()
    Stats.Refreshes += 1
    Stats.Players = 0
    Stats.Loot = 0

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = player.Character
            local root = character
                and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if root then
                Stats.Players += 1

                local data = RenderedPlayers[player]

                if not data or data.Character ~= character then
                    createPlayer(player)
                    data = RenderedPlayers[player]
                end

                if data then
                    local role = Config.RoleDetection
                        and getRole(character) or "Unknown"

                    local allowed =
                        (role == "Criminal" and Config.Criminals)
                        or (role == "Police" and Config.Police)
                        or (role == "Civilian" and Config.Civilians)
                        or (role == "Unknown" and Config.Unknown)

                    local distance = getDistance(character)
                    local inRange = not distance
                        or distance <= Config.MaxDistance

                    local color = Colors[role] or Colors.Unknown

                    local text = player.DisplayName .. "\n" .. role

                    if Config.WeaponInfo then
                        text ..= "\n" .. getWeapons(player)
                    end

                    if Config.ShowDistance and distance then
                        text ..= " | " .. distance .. " studs"
                    end

                    data.Label.Text = text
                    data.Label.TextColor3 = color

                    data.Billboard.Enabled =
                        Config.PlayerESP and allowed and inRange

                    data.Highlight.Enabled =
                        Config.PlayerESP and allowed and inRange

                    data.Highlight.FillColor = color
                    data.Highlight.OutlineColor = color
                end
            else
                removePlayer(player)
            end
        end
    end

    local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ActiveMap")
    local folder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Loot")

    if folder then
        for _, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("BasePart") then
                Stats.Loot += 1

                if not RenderedLoot[item] then
                    createLoot(item)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for item in pairs(RenderedLoot) do
        if not item.Parent then
            removeLoot(item)
        else
            local data = RenderedLoot[item]

            data.Billboard.Enabled = Config.LootESP
            data.Highlight.Enabled = Config.LootESP
        end
    end
end

-- DASHBOARD GUI

Dashboard:Section({
    Title = "System Status",
    Box = true,
})

local DashboardParagraph = Dashboard:Paragraph({
    Title = "Inspector Status",
    Desc = "Initializing...",
})

Dashboard:Button({
    Title = "Refresh All",
    Icon = "refresh-cw",
    Callback = function()
        update()
    end,
})

-- PLAYER GUI

PlayersTab:Section({
    Title = "Player ESP",
    Box = true,
})

PlayersTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Enable Player ESP",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.PlayerESP = v
        update()
    end,
})

PlayersTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Criminals",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.Criminals = v
        update()
    end,
})

PlayersTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Police",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.Police = v
        update()
    end,
})

PlayersTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Civilians",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.Civilians = v
        update()
    end,
})

PlayersTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Show Weapons",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.WeaponInfo = v
        update()
    end,
})

PlayersTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Show Distance",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.ShowDistance = v
        update()
    end,
})

-- LOOT GUI

LootTab:Section({
    Title = "Loot ESP",
    Box = true,
})

LootTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Enable Loot ESP",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.LootESP = v
        update()
    end,
})

-- SETTINGS GUI

SettingsTab:Section({
    Title = "General Settings",
    Box = true,
})

SettingsTab:Slider({
    Title = "Refresh Rate",
    Value = {
        Min = 1,
        Max = 5,
        Default = 1,
    },
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.RefreshRate = v
    end,
})

SettingsTab:Slider({
    Title = "Maximum Distance",
    Value = {
        Min = 100,
        Max = 2000,
        Default = 1000,
    },
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.MaxDistance = v
        update()
    end,
})

SettingsTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Automatic Updates",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        Config.AutoRefresh = v
    end,
})

-- PLAYER LIFECYCLE

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removePlayer(player)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        update()
    end)
end)

-- MAIN LOOP

task.spawn(function()
    while Window do
        if Config.AutoRefresh then
            update()

            DashboardParagraph:SetDesc(string.format(
                "Status: Running\nPlayers: %d\nLoot: %d\nRefreshes: %d",
                Stats.Players,
                Stats.Loot,
                Stats.Refreshes
            ))
        end

        task.wait(Config.RefreshRate)
    end
end)

update()

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "HEISTBLOX Inspector",
    Content = "AIO v0.5 initialized successfully.",
    Duration = 4,
})
